title: The Chieftain's Feast
offer: My daughter Thora turns twelve! A feast with the whole valley: bring me three crates of mead and two of cheese, within three days.

steps.say: The mead! The skalds will sing.
Cheese, mead, songs and a fire! Come in, sit by me: it is the best birthday ever.

fact: A chieftain's hall had a long fire in the middle, and benches along the walls.
